title: pvGenerateTimeSteps
body:
## pvGenerateTimeSteps

Passes its input through unchanged (shallow copy) but declares a new list of time steps (TimeStepValues), ignoring any time steps the input reports. Use it to give static or untimed data a time axis, so temporal filters or time-dependent scenes downstream have steps to work with. It only relabels: a request for one of the new times is passed upstream unchanged, so static input returns the same data at every step and nothing is interpolated.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- To create intermediate states of genuinely transient data use pvTemporalInterpolator instead.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateTimeSteps`. Identity: `filters/GenerateTimeSteps`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
